summary: Makes undead less effective against the wearer and grants Turn Undead.

fields.Defence: Clothing, base AC 10 plus Dexterity modifier. Undead have Disadvantage on attacks against you. You have Advantage on saves against undead actions and spells.
fields.Turn Undead: Item Action once per Long Rest. Undead within 30 ft who can see you must pass a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or become Turned for 3 turns. Also affects Malefic Possession. A turned creature flees, cannot spend reactions, and can Dash or try to escape immobilisation. Damage ends Turned.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
